questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Libraries support inclusion when services respond to residents' needs.
options: Libraries support inclusion when services respond to residents' needs.
Buying computers automatically removes every barrier.
A library's only useful service is lending books.
A building alone guarantees equal access.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Libraries support inclusion when services respond to residents' needs.

source.en: In this way, a public library can respond to changing needs and remain a useful part of community life.
source.tr: Bu şekilde bir halk kütüphanesi değişen ihtiyaçlara yanıt verebilir ve toplum yaşamının yararlı bir parçası olmaya devam edebilir.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: Buying computers automatically removes every barrier.
options: Buying computers automatically removes every barrier.
Maya is a university student, and she visits her local library twice a week.
A town council wanted to understand why some residents rarely visited its public library.
In this way, a public library can respond to changing needs and remain a useful part of community life.
questions.explanation: Diğer üç seçenek metinde bulunur. Seçilen iddia metnin verdiği bilgilerle uyuşmaz. Ana düşünce: Libraries support inclusion when services respond to residents' needs.

source.en: Maya is a university student, and she visits her local library twice a week. A town council wanted to understand why some residents rarely visited its public library. In this way, a public library can respond to changing needs and remain a useful part of community life.

questions.prompt:

Instead of buying more equipment immediately, the council asked residents about their daily routines.
questions.answer: Belediye hemen daha fazla ekipman almak yerine kent sakinlerine günlük düzenlerini sordu.

Bir belediye bazı kent sakinlerinin halk kütüphanesine neden nadiren gittiğini anlamak istedi.

Anket iki temel engeli ortaya çıkardı: uygun olmayan saatler ve hizmetler hakkında bilgi eksikliği.
questions.explanation: Doğru çeviri: Belediye hemen daha fazla ekipman almak yerine kent sakinlerine günlük düzenlerini sordu.
